candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory POST /v1/reservations to return 503, order POST /v1/orders to fail with transport ReadTimeout and 502, and gateway POST /v1/checkout to return 502 after ~2s.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side telemetry (server metrics/logs) not observed; timeout cause (saturation, network, config) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show a consistent chain: redis.reserve_inventory timeout -> inventory 503 -> order transport ReadTimeout/502 -> gateway checkout 502 at ~2s. Gateway metrics show checkout 502s and p95 ~2387ms while /readyz stays healthy, and topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis service metrics/logs showing latency, saturation, or connection errors during the incident window
Inventory service logs confirming the redis reserve_inventory timeout origin
